plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch-adjusted design
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 kidney samples (6 treated, 6 control) were processed in two known batches, each holding both conditions — a balanced blocking design that supports adjusting for batch as a covariate without confounding it with the condition of interest. The pipeline: (1) QC on variance-stabilized counts to confirm samples cluster by condition rather than batch and to catch outliers; (2) minimal low-count pre-filtering; (3) DESeq2 with design ~ batch + condition, explicit reference level (control), Wald test; (4) apeglm shrinkage of the condition log2FC; (5) BH-adjusted results at padj<0.05 with independent filtering; (6) a robustness cross-check with edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design, reporting the DESeq2/edgeR overlap as the high-confidence gene set; (7) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways as follow-up collections; (8) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), p-value histogram, the DE and enrichment tables, leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene-set collection versions, seeds).
